name: session-retention-safety

graded_by.test: owed: session history session-retention-safety provider test

description: With the provider clock controlled, exercise removal directly, never a sweep deadline. No record is removed before ended_at + retention; equality is eligible, not a removal deadline. A missing ended_at ages from persisted activity_at, not client_touch_at or created_at. An expired record remains listed and GET-readable until successfully removed, including deletion failure and restart. Only fully finalised killed/terminated ends qualify: durable end marker and audit complete, worker release/reconciliation complete, no unreleased worker obligation. Live, detached, orphan-pending, unreachable and unfinished ends survive regardless of age. Recheck eligibility atomically and prevent pending writers resurrecting a removed record. No shared connection or sibling session is deleted. Audit and recording bytes remain identical, and no recording-retention policy is introduced. Published e4 so surfaces can build against the shape; required-green e5 so the addition does not retroactively fail the existing e4 provider.
